title: LLMs Prompted for Legal Context Refuse More: Overrefusal from Small On-Premises LLMs in Criminal Legal Context
reasoning: The paper evaluates over-refusal of large language models in a legal context by testing authority-style prefixes. Although one of the prompt categories from OR-Bench used in the evaluation is 'unethical', the study's focus is on safety alignment failures (over-refusal) rather than benchmarking or evaluating ethical, moral, or religious reasoning.
